verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a website crawler (firecrawl-gh-3), so this axis applies. The only on-topic evidence is a community comment implying site owners can opt out by disallowing the 'FireCrawlAgent' user agent, which suggests robots.txt directives for its agent are honored (firecrawl-comm-8). No documentation shows robots.txt handling as a crawl setting, and nothing addresses target-site rate limits or politeness throttling. Missing for 10: first-party docs on robots.txt compliance and whether it can be configured, any automatic per-site rate limiting or crawl-delay support, and hands-on corroboration.
